title: Cultural Encoding in Large Language Models: The Existence Gap in AI-Mediated Brand Discovery

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing brand mention rates and sentiment in LLM outputs for 30 different brands (categorized as Western, Chinese, or Global/Mixed) across 3 International and 3 Chinese LLMs using identical pure-English queries to isolate the effects of training data geography.
Evaluating algorithmic visibility by measuring how often LLMs recommend brands based on the geographic alignment between the brand's origin and the LLM's dominant training data region.
